node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-stage3-raw-merge to the Stage-3 datum just furnished and choose one resulting extended D_3*t-isomorphism v:B_U oplus B_V->A_R with ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=D_3*t. Construct the composite Stage-3 raw-call record whose literal output is u_3:=v, without identifying it with any prior envelope output. Since D_3*t<=D_*t, lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone makes this same u_3 an extended D_*t-isomorphism, in particular an extended D_*t-inclusion, and the unit estimate weakens to D_*t.
